description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_HostBlacklist' is part of the HTMLPurifier library and implements a URI filter that blocks certain hostnames based on a blacklist configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_HostBlacklist
classes.description: A URI filter class that blocks hostnames matching entries in a blacklist.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the blacklist from configuration data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Determines if the URI's host matches any blacklisted fragment and filters it accordingly.
